subject: general
question: The Kamet peak of Himalaya is located in which state of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **'Uttarakhand'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kamet, mountain peak of the Himalayas in **Uttarakhand state, northern India, near the border with the Tibet Autonomous Region of China**. Part of the Zaskar Range, it is 25,446 feet (7,756 meters) high and was first climbed in 1931.
 
• Kamet is known to Tibetans as '**Kangmen**' which signifies 'huge grandmother of a sacred snow chain'. 
 
• While Frank Smythe writes in his book 'Kamet Conquered' that Kamet comes from the Tibetan word 'Kangmed'.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Nearest town to** Kamet is Joshimath**. ROAD: Joshimath has good connectivity of roads from cities like Rishikesh, Haridwar and Dehradun. 
 
• One can reach to these places **from Delhi and get a bus or shared taxi to Joshimath**. The buses usually leave early morning from places like Haridwar and Rishikesh.
 
• The Himalayas, the** tallest mountain range** in the globe, is home to Mount Everest and nine out of the ten highest peaks in the world.
 
• These mountains, sometimes known as the **Third Pole**, are the source of several of Asia's major rivers and have a role in controlling the climate of the world.
